visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue and white striped shirt sits at a mahjong table, looking intensely at his tiles with a strained, concentrated facial expression. He is surrounded by several women standing in the background and another man in a blue suit sitting across from him in a bright studio environment. (2) Close-up shots show hands rapidly arranging and moving white mahjong tiles with blue backings on the table surface. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the details of the tiles and the wood texture of the table. (3) The camera captures top-down views of the square mahjong layout as tiles are discarded into the center area. Graphical overlays of specific tiles occasionally appear on the screen to highlight the gameplay progress. (4) The man in the blue suit smiles and reveals his winning tiles as a shower of gold coins and 'Self-Draw' text appear over the frame. The man in the striped shirt reacts with a shocked, open-mouthed expression while the people in the background clap and laugh.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic, high-tempo synthesized BGM plays. A male voice (Kuan Kuan) speaks with a bright, energetic pitch about the difficulty of the game. Sharp rhythmic clacking sounds of mahjong tiles being moved are layered over the speech. (2) The vocal pitch rises as the speaker jokes about high school missions, accompanied by laughter from female voices in the background. A digital 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs as the scene changes. (3) Rapid-fire counting of tiles ('50,000', '60,000') creates a percussive vocal rhythm. Each tile being placed on the table creates a distinct, sharp metallic-sounding click. (4) A loud, triumphant 'ding' and shimmering sound effect signal a win. The audio concludes with a chorus of 'Oh!' exclamations, loud laughter, and a comedic musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a humorous and high-energy moment from a mahjong competition variety show, emphasizing the veteran player's sudden win and the younger player's dramatic reaction for entertainment.
